title: REQ · Admin round endpoints are registered from a route table and reject missing and wrong tokens
summary: The five admin round routes are declared in one table used for registration, and each returns 401 for missing or wrong tokens.
description: Context: round routes are registered inline in server.New (server.go L101-L111). Desired behavior: a table of adminRoute{Method, Pattern, Handler} drives registration so tests can iterate the same list. Expected result: missing and wrong bearer tokens yield 401 on every round route.
acceptance_criteria: Given the round route table, when built, then it lists POST /rounds, POST /rounds/{id}/open, POST /rounds/{id}/close, GET /rounds/{id}, GET /rounds/{id}/contributions.
Given a server with token 'tok', when a round route is called with no token or 'Bearer wrong', then the response is 401.

in_scope: adminRoute type and round entries in server.go

technical_constraints: Keep admin.Middleware applied to the /api/v1/admin group
definition_of_done: Round routes registered from the table
